title: Divisorial persistent homology and volume asymptotics of complex pairs
summary: To a log-resolution of a complex pair $(X,\I)$ we associate the weights $λ_E=(a_E+1)/ν_E$ of the prime divisors $E$ of the total transform of $\I$, where $ν_E$ is the vanishing order of $\I$ and $a_E$ the Jacobian (Mather discrepancy) order along $E$. On Jacobian-adapted resolutions, $\min_Eλ_E$ is the volume-growth exponent of $K_\I=\sum_j|f_j|^2$ for the $2n$-dimensional Hausdorff measure: the log canonical threshold for smooth $X$, Ishii's Mather one for singular $X$, with a logarithmic correction given by a resonance multiplicity.
